description: Start asynchronous contact enrichment for businesses the user already has. This uses Pay on Find. First call check_account, calculate and state the maximum cost for the selected outputs, and obtain confirmation. The ceiling is the lower of available credits and business count times the selected per-business costs (business email 1, owner email 2, owner phone 5). Starting the job requires at least 1 credit per business during a trial or 1.5 credits per business on a paid plan. Use one stable idempotency_key for retries.

google_maps_url.description: Google Maps listing URL, including maps.app.goo.gl short links. Used to resolve Maps-only rows or infer missing location evidence.
google_maps_url.title: Google Maps Url

place_id.description: Google Place ID used to resolve a Maps-only row or missing location evidence.
place_id.title: Place Id

website_url.description: Public HTTP(S) business website to inspect. When business_name is also supplied, that pair is the canonical identity and takes precedence over Maps identifiers.
website_url.title: Website Url

business_emails.description: Find public business inboxes such as info@ and contact@.
business_emails.title: Business Emails

businesses.description: Businesses to enrich. Each needs a Google Maps URL, Place ID, or both a business name and website URL. Prefer name and website when available; they become the canonical identity and Maps identifiers remain optional fallback metadata.
businesses.title: Businesses

confirmed_credit_cost.description: Maximum Pay-on-Find credit cost the user explicitly approved.
confirmed_credit_cost.title: Confirmed Credit Cost

country_code.description: Default ISO country code. Required only when a business is supplied by name and website without a Maps URL or Place ID. Recommended whenever name and website are supplied so Mapsdata can skip Maps resolution.
country_code.title: Country Code

idempotency_key.description: Stable unique key to make retries safe.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

name.description: Optional display name for the job.
name.title: Name

owner_phones.description: Find direct owner and decision-maker phone numbers.
owner_phones.title: Owner Phones

name: enrich_businesses
title: Enrich supplied businesses
